properties.name: Bowmanville GO Extension
properties.timeline: Metrolinx is extending Lakeshore East GO service nearly 20 kilometres from Durham College Oshawa GO Station to Bowmanville.
properties.description: The Bowmanville Extension adds 18.7 kilometres of track, bridges, signals, and crossing upgrades to bring two-way GO rail service farther into Durham Region.
properties.geometry_note: Corridor geometry is approximate; authoritative station points were not added from the project page.

properties.name: Ballard Link Extension
properties.timeline: Sound Transit is advancing environmental review and design for the Ballard Link Extension, with construction scheduled after the current planning phase.
properties.description: The Ballard Link Extension would connect SODO, downtown Seattle, Interbay, and Ballard through a new downtown light rail tunnel and regional extension.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate preferred-corridor concept; station points were not added from the current project page.

properties.name: West Phoenix High-Capacity Transit Corridor
properties.timeline: Phoenix and Valley Metro are reprioritizing high-capacity transit planning along Indian School Road in West Phoenix after exiting the Capitol Extension project-development process.
properties.description: A planned high-capacity transit corridor along Indian School Road serving West Phoenix and the Maryvale area.
properties.geometry_note: Planning corridor; mode, alignment, and stations remain subject to project development.

properties.name: Colorado Connector
properties.timeline: The Colorado Connector is advancing a delivery plan for starter passenger-rail service between Fort Collins and Denver in 2029, with planned expansion south toward Pueblo.
properties.description: A planned express intercity passenger train connecting Front Range communities from Fort Collins through Denver to Pueblo, using existing rail corridors.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Front Range corridor; final station and operating details remain in delivery planning.

properties.name: Lackawanna Cut-Off Restoration
properties.timeline: NJ TRANSIT is restoring passenger rail from Port Morris to a new Andover station, including track, signals, the Roseville Tunnel, and right-of-way improvements.
properties.description: The first funded segment restores approximately 7.3 miles of passenger rail service in western New Jersey along the Lackawanna Cut-Off.
properties.geometry_note: Initial Port Morris–Andover segment shown; the longer Scranton extension is not included because it remains uncommitted.

properties.name: New River Valley Passenger Rail Project
properties.agency: Virginia Passenger Rail Authority / Amtrak Virginia
properties.timeline: Construction is underway to extend Amtrak Virginia service from Roanoke to Christiansburg in the New River Valley.
properties.description: The project upgrades rail infrastructure and the Christiansburg station to restore passenger service to the New River Valley.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Roanoke–Christiansburg corridor; station points were not added from the project announcement.
